Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
GENERAL STATISTICS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the General Statistics Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
26-2-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the General Statistics
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 13 Act LXIX of 1975

ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
GENERAL STATISTICS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VII OF 2000
An Ordinance to
amend the General Statistics Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
26-2-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 13,
Act LXIX of 1975.--In the General Statistics Act, 1975 (LXIX of 1975)
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 13,---
(i) for the words "one thousand"
the words "seven thousand" shall be substituted; and
(ii) for the words "five
hundred" the words "three thousand five hundred" shall be
substituted.
